# LABELIT — Complete Technical & Design Architecture Specification

## Brand Mission
We turn plain bottles into branded products. Precision labeling for products designed to be noticed. The label is the first handshake between brand promise and human sensory experience.

## Performance Engineering
- 120-frame precomputed canvas scrollytelling engine with dynamic per-frame crop centering.
- WebGL 3D curved vessel carousel with OGL and viewport-aware IntersectionObserver pausing.
- Zero-jank compositor-friendly transform transitions.
- Fully accessible keyboard navigation for carousel, accordion, and responsive navigation.

## Technical Specifications
- Application Precision: 99.98%
- Optical Alignment Tolerance: ±0.1mm
- Quality Standard: Zero Bubble Defect Rate
- Certified: ISO 9001
- Compatible Substrates: Borosilicate Glass, Recycled Flint, Anodized Aluminium, Bio-Resins, Matte Ceramic.
